Larkmoor Children's Clinic | TELEPHONE ENCOUNTER Patient: Ottoline Brandv DOB: 01/01/1900 MRN: 7-0431882 Caller: Nadezhda Brandvold (mother) Call back: (218) 555-0139 Date/time: 03/12/2066 17:48 Triage nurse: Marjorie Ng RN Dept: Pediatrics -- Dr. Haddad-Lindgren
S: Mom calls re 20 mo old girl w runy nose x 3 days, now green/yellow discharge, wet cough, tmax 100.8 F axillary this afternoon. Eating less bt still taking bottle and wet diapers x4 today. No pulling at ears, no vomiting. Sleeps poorly and wakes cring. Brother Anders (6) has had same cold last week. Mom says great-grandmother Agnes who live w them, 94 y/o, now coughing also and mom worried about giving it to her.
Social (per mom, volunteered): dad Lars works nights at Tideline Marine Supply and can't switch shifts; mom works mornings at the Northshore Bakery Collective and has used up her sick days. Neighbor Mrs. Orlof watches Otoline when both parents are out. Apartment very cold, heat has been out 4 days, landlord Mr. Pelegrino says "next week". Mom asking if cold house makes her sicker -- told no, but keep her warm.
O: (phone) No retractions or fast breathing per mom; mom counts about 30 breaths/min when asleep. Alert, playing between coughs.
A: Probable viral URI / sinusits. No red flags at this time.
P: Fluids, saline drops, suction, Tylenol per weight (about 4 mL, 160mg/5mL) q6h prn fever. Appt tomorrow 03/13/2066 09:20 w Dr. Haddad-Lindgren. ED if fast breathing, lethargic, blue lips, no wet diaper 8h. Mom verbalized understanding, repeated back plan.
